steps.instruction: Do not change anything; leave Button 4 assigned to Mouse Function > Back.
During capture set Button 4 to Windows Shortcut > Cycle Apps exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Windows Shortcut > Switch Apps exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Windows Shortcut > Cut exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Windows Shortcut > Copy exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Windows Shortcut > Paste exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Windows Shortcut > Undo exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Windows Shortcut > Cycle Apps exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Windows Shortcut > Switch Apps exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Windows Shortcut > Cut exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Windows Shortcut > Copy exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Windows Shortcut > Paste exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Windows Shortcut > Undo exactly once.
During capture restore Button 4 to Mouse Function > Back exactly once.
